ns2:section.sectionText: This advanced course will focus on the process understanding of ecohydrology (e.g. physical hydrology, plant water use and stress response), the societal applications of ecohydrology (e.g. irrigation, drought monitoring, water sustainability for ecosystem), and the start-of-the-art methodology to study ecohydrology (e.g. satellite, numerical modeling). The targeted students are upper class undergraduates who have interests in gaining an ecohydrology background and knowing its broader applications, or early-stage graduate students who aim to adopt ecohydrology knowledge in their research.
